title: It should have some NEEDED updates!
body: In general it’s great but it has a few things missing out for example the lines and grids aren’t to write on and the note can’t change in multiply colours. It‘s white all the time. Also I would like the notes app to create a board with all photos we add to the note (ofcourse they would get smaller but at least they would look organized because most of the photos added are just to point sth out or to remember a specific moment. Also it can have the option to click and zoom in the photo we want..). The last thing I would like to add would be to change the font or it’s size. I think it would be great and really helpfull for all users to be added these changes. Except for these it’s a great app.
